scenes.location: Cliffside at dawn, overlooking the iron‑colored sea
scenes.lighting: soft golden sunrise, warm amber glow
cool blue moonlight mixed with warm amber, chiaroscuro

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the cliff, showing the vast ocean and the horizon, with a small figure on the edge, father and daughter facing the sea.
Medium close‑up of 7‑year‑old玛莲, her hair fluttering, eyes bright, clutching a brass compass, father's hand on her back.
Overhead view of the father teaching the child to read the sky, steam rising from a nearby rusted furnace, highlighting industrial background.
Close‑up of the daughter's face, tears glistening, as she looks at the sea, with a faint memory of the father's voice echoing.
Wide shot of the same cliff at dusk, sky painted with cold blue moonlight and warm amber, daughter standing alone with a pocket watch.
